records.jp: 私は司城来夢。改めて、みんなよろしく
records.en_original: My name is Lime Shijou. It's nice to re-meet you all.
records.en_auxiliary: My name is Lime Shijou. It's nice to re-meet you all.
records.en: My name is Shijou Lime. It's nice to re-meet you all.

records.jp: うん、よろしく！
records.en_original: Nice to meet you!
records.en_auxiliary: Nice to meet you!
records.en: Nice to meet you!

records.jp: じゃなくて！！　いやよろしくだけど！　<CR>いろいろ聞かなきゃいけないことがあるでしょ！
records.en_original: Wait a minute! I have so many questions!
records.en_auxiliary: Wait a minute! I have so many questions!
records.en: Wait a minute! I have so many questions!

records.jp: た、たしかに！　なんで起きれちゃったの！？
records.en_original: Sh-she's right! Why did you wake up anyway?
records.en_auxiliary: Sh-she's right! Why did you wake up anyway?
records.en: Sh-she's right! Why did you wake up anyway?

records.jp: 起きてしまって大丈夫なの……？<CR>あなたがこの世界を維持してるって話だったわよね？
records.en_original: Are we sure it's safe for her to be awake...? Aren't you the one holding this world together?
records.en_auxiliary: Are we sure it's safe for her to be awake...? Aren't you the one holding this world together?
records.en: Are we sure it's safe for her to be awake...? Aren't you the one holding this world together?

records.jp: うん、安心して。そこは大丈夫。<CR>それで、なんで起きれたのか、だけど……
records.en_original: It's okay, you don't need to worry about that. As for why I woke up...
records.en_auxiliary: It's okay, you don't need to worry about that. As for why I woke up...
records.en: It's okay, you don't need to worry about that. As for why I woke up...

records.jp: みんなが作ってくれたでしょ？<CR>クマのぬいぐるみ
records.en_original: You all made the teddy bear for me, didn't you?
records.en_auxiliary: You all made the teddy bear for me, didn't you?
records.en: You all made the teddy bear for me, didn't you?

records.jp: えっ、クマさん……？<CR>それが起きれた理由……？
records.en_original: The teddy bear? That's why you woke up?
records.en_auxiliary: The teddy bear? That's why you woke up?
records.en: The teddy bear? That's why you woke up?

records.jp: な、なんでクマのぬいぐるみで<CR>起きることができたの……？
records.en_original: Why did that wake you up?
records.en_auxiliary: Why did that wake you up?
records.en: Why did that wake you up?

records.jp: 考え方は、みんなをこの世界に集める方法と同じ。<CR>雫世界に思い出に関わるものを用意する
records.en_original: The same way I was able to bring you all to this world. By creating something in Oasis related to a memory.
records.en_auxiliary: The same way I was able to bring you all to this world. By creating something in Oasis related to a memory.
records.en: The same way I was able to bring you all to this world. By creating something in Oasis related to a memory.

records.jp: そして、想いを共鳴させる。<CR>そうやってライムは目覚めたんだ
records.en_original: And when my feelings resonated with it, I was able to wake up.
records.en_auxiliary: And when my feelings resonated with it, I was able to wake up.
records.en: And the feelings resonated. That's how Lime woke up.

records.jp: でも、クマのぬいぐるみはきっかけでしかない
records.en_original: The stuffed bear just acted as the catalyst.
records.en_auxiliary: The stuffed bear just acted as the catalyst.
records.en: The stuffed bear just acted as the catalyst.

records.jp: ライムが起きることができた根本的な理由は、別にある
records.en_original: There's another, more fundamental reason why I was able to wake up.
records.en_auxiliary: There's another, more fundamental reason why I was able to wake up.
records.en: There is another, more fundamental reason Lime was able to wake up.

records.jp: ライム、みんなに改めて説明してあげてほしい。<CR>なぜライムが眠ることになったのか
records.en_original: Lime, could you explain to everyone again why you were sleeping in the first place?
records.en_auxiliary: Lime, could you explain to everyone again why you were sleeping in the first place?
records.en: Lime, could you explain to everyone again why you were sleeping in the first place?

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: ...Sure.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Sure.
records.en: ...Sure.

records.jp: ●カット
●カット
●カット
●カット
ライムが眠ることになったのは、雫世界を生み出す時に<CR>みんなをここに集めることができなかったから
records.en_original: The reason I was sleeping is because we failed to bring everyone together here when we created Oasis.
records.en_auxiliary: The reason I was sleeping is because we failed to bring everyone together here when we created Oasis.
records.en: Lime fell asleep because Yuzu and Lime failed to bring everyone together here when they created Oasis.

records.jp: ここに集めることができなかった、っていうのは……？
records.en_original: You couldn't bring everyone together? What do you mean...?
records.en_auxiliary: You couldn't bring everyone together? What do you mean...?
records.en: You couldn't bring everyone together? What do you mean...?

records.jp: 詩帆ちゃんやヒナちゃん、他のみんなもそうだけど……<CR>最初は学校にいなかったでしょ？
records.en_original: Hina, Shiho, the others... They weren't at school in the beginning, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Hina, Shiho, the others... They weren't at school in the beginning, right?
records.en: Hina-chan, Shiho-chan, the others... They weren't at school in the beginning, right?

records.jp: う、うん
records.en_original: R-right.
records.en_auxiliary: R-right.
records.en: R-right.

records.jp: 本当は、最初からみんなを<CR>この世界に集めるはずだったんだよ
records.en_original: Initially, everyone was supposed to be brought to this world at the same time.
records.en_auxiliary: Initially, everyone was supposed to be brought to this world at the same time.
records.en: Initially, everyone was supposed to be brought to this world at the same time.

records.jp: それって、逆に言えば……<CR>私たちはバラバラの状態からスタートしたってこと？
records.en_original: So we were separated from the start?
records.en_auxiliary: So we were separated from the start?
records.en: So we were separated from the start?

records.jp: そういうこと
records.en_original: Exactly.
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly.
records.en: Exactly.

records.jp: それぞれの想いを核にして、『雫』は形作られた。<CR>でも個人個人の雫は小さくて、危うい
records.en_original: And so each person's emotions formed like dewdrops. But one by itself is small and fragile.
records.en_auxiliary: And so each person's emotions formed like dewdrops. But one by itself is small and fragile.
records.en: And so each person's emotions formed like dewdrops. But one by itself is small and fragile.

records.jp: だからユズたちは、小さな雫を<CR>一つに集めて大きな雫にしようって思ったんだけど――
records.en_original: And so we decided to gather all the individual dewdrops into a single body, Oasis...
records.en_auxiliary: And so we decided to gather all the individual dewdrops into a single body, Oasis...
records.en: So Yuzu and Lime decided to gather the little droplets into one large droplet, but—

records.jp: ……途中で失敗したんだろうね。<CR>一人一人の雫は、バラバラのまま虚無に放り出された
records.en_original: Something must have gone wrong along the way. Each person's dewdrop shattered and was expelled into the nothingness.
records.en_auxiliary: Something must have gone wrong along the way. Each person's dewdrop shattered and was expelled into the nothingness.
records.en: Something must have gone wrong along the way. Each person's dewdrop shattered and was expelled into the nothingness.

records.jp: 途中で……
records.en_original: Along the way...
records.en_auxiliary: Along the way...
records.en: Along the way...

records.jp: 失敗した……
records.en_original: Something went wrong...
records.en_auxiliary: Something went wrong...
records.en: Something went wrong...

records.jp: そしてライムは、そのあちこちに散らばった雫を、<CR>つなぎとめなくちゃいけなくなった
records.en_original: And so I had to gather the broken dewdrops and put them back together.
records.en_auxiliary: And so I had to gather the broken dewdrops and put them back together.
records.en: And Lime had to hold together the droplets scattered all over the place.

records.jp: ライムは、『雫』という小さな船が<CR>どこかへ行かないよう、船のいかりになってたってこと
records.en_original: Lime was the anchor that kept our lifeboat that is Oasis from drifting off.
records.en_auxiliary: Lime was the anchor that kept our lifeboat that is Oasis from drifting off.
records.en: Lime was the anchor that kept our lifeboat that is Oasis from drifting off.

records.jp: つなぎとめるには想定以上の力が必要で、二人とも<CR>想いの力を大きく消費することになっちゃったけどね
records.en_original: It took more power than I expected to put them together. And the two of us spent a great deal of emotional energy in the process.
records.en_auxiliary: It took more power than I expected to put them together. And the two of us spent a great deal of emotional energy in the process.
records.en: It took more power than I expected to put them together. And the two of us spent a great deal of emotional energy in the process.

records.jp: ●カット
そっか、だからユズもあんなふうに……
records.en_original: So that explains what happened to Yuzu too...
records.en_auxiliary: So that explains what happened to Yuzu too...
records.en: So that explains what happened to Yuzu too...

records.jp: ●カット
なんでそんなことになってしまったのかは<CR>思い出せないけど……それでひとまず、どうにかなった
records.en_original: I can't remember exactly why it came to that, but that's how it happened.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't remember exactly why it came to that, but that's how it happened.
records.en: I can't remember exactly why it came to that, but that's how it happened.

records.jp: 現状維持が可能になった、ってだけだけどね……
records.en_original: Or at least, how we got to where we are.
records.en_auxiliary: Or at least, how we got to where we are.
records.en: Or at least, how we got to where we are.

records.jp: 今はこうして、全員がこの世界に集まったから、<CR>負担が減って……
records.en_original: Now that everyone has gathered here, the burden isn't so heavy...
records.en_auxiliary: Now that everyone has gathered here, the burden isn't so heavy...
records.en: Now that everyone has gathered here, the burden isn't so heavy...

records.jp: ライムが眠る必要がなくなった？
records.en_original: So Lime doesn't need to sleep anymore?
records.en_auxiliary: So Lime doesn't need to sleep anymore?
records.en: So Lime doesn't need to sleep anymore?

records.jp: そういうこと！　ただ、起きれたとはいえ、<CR>想いの力はたくさん消費しちゃったから……
records.en_original: That's right! Though I still had to use a large amount of emotional energy.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right! Though I still had to use a large amount of emotional energy.
records.en: That's right! Though I still had to use a large amount of emotional energy.

records.jp: ユズたちにはもう戦う力も残ってないんだ。ごめん
records.en_original: I'm afraid we don't have any strength left to fight. I'm sorry.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm afraid we don't have any strength left to fight. I'm sorry.
records.en: Yuzu and Lime have no power left to fight. Sorry.

records.jp: 謝らないでよ。こっちからすれば、<CR>守ってくれたことに大感謝なんだから
records.en_original: Don't apologize. We should be grateful to you for protecting us.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't apologize. We should be grateful to you for protecting us.
records.en: Don't apologize. We should be grateful to you for protecting us.

records.jp: 本当はもっと早くみんなに伝えたかった。<CR>詩ちゃんが来た時点で、準備は整ってたんだけど――
records.en_original: I wanted to tell you all sooner. The preparations were complete when Uta arrived.
records.en_auxiliary: I wanted to tell you all sooner. The preparations were complete when Uta arrived.
records.en: I wanted to tell you all sooner. The preparations were complete when Uta-chan arrived.

クラック……
records.en_original: The Crack...
records.en_auxiliary: The Crack...
records.en: The Crack...

records.jp: ……うん。修復にかかりっきりで、<CR>ここまで時間がかかっちゃった
records.en_original: That's right. It's taken me until now to fix it...
records.en_auxiliary: That's right. It's taken me until now to fix it...
records.en: That's right. It's taken me until now to fix it...

records.jp: 想定外のことばっかりだね……
records.en_original: Nothing went according to plan, huh...
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing went according to plan, huh...
records.en: Nothing went according to plan, huh...

records.jp: ご、ごめんなさい……私のせいで……
records.en_original: I-I'm sorry... It's all my fault...
records.en_auxiliary: I-I'm sorry... It's all my fault...
records.en: I-I'm sorry... It's all my fault...

records.jp: 起きちゃったことは仕方ないよ。<CR>悪気はなかったんだろうし
records.en_original: It's all water under the bridge. I'm sure you didn't mean any harm.
records.en_auxiliary: It's all water under the bridge. I'm sure you didn't mean any harm.
records.en: It's all water under the bridge. I'm sure you didn't mean any harm.

records.jp: それで……あの後も、いろいろあったんだよね？<CR>何があったのか、教えてもらってもいい？
records.en_original: I'm sure a lot has happened since then, would you mind telling me about it?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure a lot has happened since then, would you mind telling me about it?
records.en: I'm sure a lot has happened since then, would you mind telling me about it?

records.jp: あたしが直接話す
records.en_original: Allow me.
records.en_auxiliary: Allow me.
records.en: Allow me.

records.jp: ってことで、あたしは世界システムの一部になった
records.en_original: ...and so that's how I came to be a part of the World System.
records.en_auxiliary: ...and so that's how I came to be a part of the World System.
records.en: ...and so that's how I came to be a part of the World System.

records.jp: それは……そっか、なるほど……。<CR>だから断続的に攻撃され続けてるのか……
records.en_original: I see... It all makes sense now. That explains the intermittent attacks...
records.en_auxiliary: I see... It all makes sense now. That explains the intermittent attacks...
records.en: I see... It all makes sense now. That explains the intermittent attacks...

records.jp: ものすごく危険、ではあるね。でも――
records.en_original: That means we're still in danger as long as—
records.en_auxiliary: That means we're still in danger as long as—
records.en: That means we're still in danger as long as—

records.jp: 決めたんだ。みんなで生き残るって
records.en_original: We all decided we're going to survive together.
records.en_auxiliary: We all decided we're going to survive together.
records.en: We all decided we're going to survive together.

records.jp: ……うん。なら、ライムから言うことはないよ。<CR>ライムも、誰かを犠牲にして生き残りたいとは思わない
records.en_original: Of course. And I won't say that you can't. It wouldn't sit right with me to have to hurt someone in order to survive.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course. And I won't say that you can't. It wouldn't sit right with me to have to hurt someone in order to survive.
records.en: ...Yeah. Then Lime has nothing more to say. Lime doesn't want to survive by sacrificing someone either.

records.jp: ……ありがとう、ライム
records.en_original: ...Thank you, Lime.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Thank you, Lime.
records.en: ...Thank you, Lime.

records.jp: 今の話を踏まえると……<CR>ますます急いだほうがいいかもね
records.en_original: But given what you've just told me, we don't have any time to waste.
records.en_auxiliary: But given what you've just told me, we don't have any time to waste.
records.en: But given what you've just told me, we don't have any time to waste.

records.jp: うん。ユズとライムの記憶を取り戻そう
records.en_original: Yeah. Let's go get our memories back.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. Let's go get our memories back.
records.en: Yeah. Let's recover Yuzu and Lime's memories.

records.jp: ――！　そっか、ライムが起きて、<CR>ユズも元通りになったから……
records.en_original: I get it! Now that Lime is awake, and Yuzu is back to normal...
records.en_auxiliary: I get it! Now that Lime is awake, and Yuzu is back to normal...
records.en: I get it! Now that Lime is awake, and Yuzu is back to normal...

records.jp: 機能停止してたユズとライムのココロトープも、<CR>元通りになってるはずだよ
records.en_original: Our Heartscape should be back to normal now.
records.en_auxiliary: Our Heartscape should be back to normal now.
records.en: Yuzu and Lime's Heartscape, which had stopped functioning, should be back to normal too.

records.jp: ユズたちのココロトープは、<CR>この世界の管理を行う中心地点でもある
records.en_original: Our Heartscape is the central point that manages this world.
records.en_auxiliary: Our Heartscape is the central point that manages this world.
records.en: Yuzu and Lime's Heartscape is also the central point that manages this world.

records.jp: だから……ようやく分かるはず
records.en_original: So we should finally be able to understand...
records.en_auxiliary: So we should finally be able to understand...
records.en: So we should finally be able to understand...

records.jp: ユズたちの住んでいた世界はどうなったのか。<CR>他のみんなは、どうなっちゃったのか……
records.en_original: About what happened to the world we all once lived in...
records.en_auxiliary: About what happened to the world we all once lived in...
records.en: What happened to the world Yuzu and Lime lived in? What happened to everyone else...?

records.jp: ●カット
●カット
――改めて、行こう。<CR>ユズとライムのココロトープに
records.en_original: Let's go to Yuzu and Lime's Heartscape.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's go to Yuzu and Lime's Heartscape.
records.en: Let's go to Yuzu and Lime's Heartscape.
